submittedPrompt: 制作一张应用导出的独立静态阅读HTML/打印文档视觉图，约1440×1100纯白整页，中央820px左右阅读正文。仅参考输入图的清晰字级/平面表面，绝不出现DooKnow品牌、owner rail、目录树、编辑/保存/打印/导出按钮、表单、网站导航、原生OS/浏览器打印窗或页码设置。source-derived的合成普通笔记，不是primary图形。最上方一块浅灰只读monospace属性pre，原样文字title: 读书笔记及custom: {x: y}，没有额外可见“属性”表单label。下方正文H1读书笔记；段落“公式 x²，见说明¹。”，x²为静态数学排版，¹为脚注锚点；提示callout显示“提示”和“保留原文，记录下一步。”；H2记录方法，两个bullet收集想法/按主题整理；普通不可点击文本相关内容；一个可点击蓝色外部资料链接；底部分割线后脚注“1. 解释”及回链。无内嵌图片（此选定变体未提供图片），不画失效预览或错误提示。无JS控件/交互编辑/原始API路径。白底深色字、细线和克制灰块；只读文档不是产品工作台截图。角色与未runtime验证只存metadata。

sourceContracts.title: Standalone exported reading HTML / app-owned print document

entry.route: Downloaded sanitized-title.html or app-created about:blank print window
entry.trigger: 导出HTML or 打印 from note/primary-diagram toolbar

permissionRules: Owner controls preparation and authorized resource resolution. The resulting standalone document has no login flow/session check; anyone receiving the actual exported file can read its included content.
CSP default-src none,img-src data:,style-src unsafe-inline,base-uri none,form-action none; no frontend scripts/external asset engines.

fields.name: 阅读正文
fields.constraints: Owner-selected current note snapshot; ordinary YAML shown as escaped属性 pre; diagrams/footnotes/callouts/static MathML; no editable fields or app chrome.

fields.name: 内嵌图片
fields.constraints: Resolved/authorized image types PNG,JPEG,GIF,WebP,AVIF,SVG; <=10MiB each; SVG validated/presentation-only; PNG containing editable diagram source rejected.

actions.label: 导出HTML
actions.effect: Download standalone script-free HTML with sanitized title<=150 characters
actions.api: Owner asset lookup GET /api/assets/:id; no API needed to read downloaded document
actions.guard: Ordinary note flushes current snapshot and strips stale previews; primary diagram saves clean coherent version and validates source/preview/render binding

actions.label: 打印
actions.effect: Open app-created document, await image decode, focus and invoke native print; window closes afterprint
actions.guard: Popup must open; unavailable popup reports existing error; no app print-settings UI exists

actions.label: 外部链接 / 文内锚点
actions.effect: Follow retained HTTP(S) non-API URLs and internal fragments
actions.guard: Other application/private/local links render as text, not navigation

importantStates: Primary diagram read-only PNG projection without original source grant
Stale inline preview notice keeps current source
Unavailable/unapproved image rejects export through existing editor error
Print popup blocked reports error and closes prepared popup on failed build

responsive.behavior: Standalone viewport meta; screen body16px/1.8 and centered main max820px,padding44px24px80px; images max-width100%, pre wraps, math can scroll. Print CSS main max-width none,padding0,body11pt, avoid breaks in pre/blockquote/table/img. Actual320/390/1440 exports unverified.

sourceContracts.designReason: Existing user-visible surface requires baseline-aligned hierarchy, controls, feedback and responsive treatment without adding behavior.
notes: Source inventory only; no runtime behavior asserted.
App-owned rendered HTML/print document is part of UI coverage. OS/browser native print dialog is explicitly excluded; do not invent print settings.

parentBindings.route: Downloaded sanitized-title.html or app-created about:blank print window

postprocessing: Original built-in PNG copied byte-for-byte; no pixel edits.

selfInspection.method: Actual native generated PNG viewed against all input images and exact source template/conditional state contracts.
concerns: Static raster is not proof of executed actions, owner/recipient permissions, focus/keyboard, guard enforcement, canvas topology or responsive fit.
Light raster shading and approximate geometry are illustrative; exact source labels and shared flat CSS tokens remain implementation requirements.
Source-derived selected component/state; actual matching runtime capture is unavailable. Supplied actual screenshot is only parent/host reference where present.

Ordinary note standalone static document variant selected with properties/math/callout/footnotes and no images. Primary diagram/image/stale-preview/error alternatives are not simultaneously drawn; native print UI excluded.
